lesson.evidence: Three approaches (FFD, BFD, multi-ordering search with 20+ trials) all converged to 6 bins matching theoretical minimum. The items form complementary pairs (8+2, 7+3, 6+4) that perfectly fill capacity-10 bins.
lesson.statement: When item weights form complementary pairs summing to bin capacity, FFD achieves optimal packing immediately.

summary: Tested FFD, BFD, and multi-ordering search (20+ trials)
Each bin utilizes full capacity of 10
Verified all 12 items packed exactly once
